title: feat(components): the filter panel offers relative dates on date rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbPw4YoBPXoEgXDh4EUyz68a)_

Fixes #29115

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表筛选面板里日期/日期时间字段的「介于」新增 13 个相对区间(今天、本周、本月、近 30 天……),「早于/晚于」新增今天、昨天、明天;选中后存的是宏(如 `{week_start}`),不再是当天的固定日期。
- **为什么改**:销售按「本周」或「早于今天」筛选并保存后,第二天、下周一筛选结果就悄悄错了,没有任何提示。
- **风险与回滚**:只改共享的筛选组件 `FilterBuilder`(列表、看板、日历、Studio 视图筛选、数据集和共享规则条件都用它);存储形状仍是普通 `ViewFilterRule`,没有新运算符、新键。回滚即 revert 本 PR,已存的宏值服务端照常解析。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`(`renderValueInput` 外包一层选择、`changeOperator` 切换运算符时清空不匹配的相对值)、`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filterRelativeDates.ts`(宏对 → 预设的反查,读 spec 表不留副本)。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-relative-dates-29115.test.tsx`,预期 49 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

On a `date` or `datetime` row of the filter builder:

- **`between`** offers the spec's `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS` (all 13, in spec order) beside `Custom…`, which keeps today's two date inputs. A chosen preset is stored as its window from `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS`, e.g. `['{week_start}', '{week_end}']`.
- **`before` / `after`** offer today, yesterday and tomorrow beside `Custom…`. A chosen point is stored as the wrapped token, e.g. `'{today}'`.
- **Read back:** a stored pair shows its preset's label after folding the `{current_*}` aliases (`DATE_MACRO_ALIAS_TOKENS`), so `['{current_week_start}', '{current_week_end}']` shows "This week". A placeholder value no preset or point matches (`['{7_days_ago}', '{tomorrow}']`) is kept, shown as its own text, and still filters. A fixed date shows as `Custom…` with its date, as before.
- **Switches:** an operator change carries a relative value only to an operator offering the same kind (`before` today → `after` today); otherwise the row starts empty, so half a window never becomes a point and no token lands in a date input that cannot show it. A field switch between two date columns keeps the value (`convertScalarToFamily` holds a date macro in the `date` / `datetime` families).
- **Labels** reuse keys every pack already has: `dashboard.filters.range.*` (the dashboard filter bar's 13 preset labels), `dashboard.filters.custom` and `fields.datePicker.tomorrow`. No i18n key is added; each is copied into the builder's defaults table verbatim from the `en` pack.

The reverse lookup lives in a new module beside the builder, `filterRelativeDates.ts`. It is not re-exported from the package entry (`custom/index.ts` lists files by name), so nothing is added to `@object-ui/components`' published surface. It reads `DATE_RANGE_PRESETS`, `DATE_RANGE_PRESET_MACRO_WINDOWS`, `DATE_MACRO_ALIAS_TOKENS`, `DATE_MACRO_WRAPPED_RE` and `isDateMacroToken` from `@objectstack/spec/data` and keeps no copy; `packages/spec` is not edited.

Not in this PR, per the card: a "last N days" input, relative values on `equals`, future-facing presets, a week-start setting, the record form's shortcuts, migrating stored absolute dates, the author `date-range` chip, the dashboard's bounds table (#29116) and the browser-versus-server clock (#29117).

## Tests

New `filter-builder-relative-dates-29115.test.tsx`, 49 tests:

- the 13 presets in spec order plus `Custom…`; each preset sends its spec window (and never a preset name), on `date` and on `datetime`; `This week` sends `['{week_start}', '{week_end}']` and the rule passes `ViewFilterRuleSchema`;
- `before` → Today sends `'{today}'`; `after` → Tomorrow on a datetime row sends `'{tomorrow}'`; the three points are spec instant tokens;
- a stored `{current_week_*}` pair shows "This week" without an emit; a stored `['{7_days_ago}', '{tomorrow}']` shows as text, keeps no date inputs, and is re-emitted unchanged; the zh pack shows 本周;
- `Custom…` keeps the date inputs and they still write dates; choosing `Custom…` from a preset clears to `[]`;
- operator and field switches as above;
- controls: `equals` on a date row, text and number rows draw no relative choice; every label key exists in all ten packs.

Ablation (committed fix first, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, test imports `src`, no dist in the path): the window leg was changed to store today's resolved date pair instead of the macro window. Result: 16 failed / 33 passed of 49, then restored (`blob == HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty).

<details><summary>Suite readings</summary>

- the 23 existing `filter-builder*` files in `packages/components`: 23/23 files, 397/397 tests green with the change (locked, `--maxWorkers=2`).
- the new file: 49/49 green.
- `@object-ui/components` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- the full `packages/components` suite: 471 files passed, 1 skipped (4530 tests passed, 24 skipped), in four locked batches.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **URL, stored preference and save-as-view** were measured with a throwaway probe (not committed) on `userFilterUrlState` and `foldFilterGroupToSpecRules`: for `['{week_start}', '{week_end}']`, `['{current_week_start}', '{current_week_end}']`, `'{today}'` on `before` and `['{7_days_ago}', '{tomorrow}']` the `uf__filter` write → read round trip and the fold return the value unchanged, and each folded rule passes `ViewFilterRuleSchema`. The live query AST is `['close_date', 'between', ['{week_start}', '{week_end}']]`, lowered by the spec to `{ close_date: { $between: [...] } }`; `before` today lowers to `$lt: '{today}'`. "Reset view" was not separately measured; it clears the panel through the existing path, which is value-agnostic.
- **Kanban and calendar hosts** were measured in jsdom with a throwaway `ListView` probe (not committed), seeding the panel with `['{current_week_start}', '{current_week_end}']`: on grid, kanban and calendar the panel shows "This week" and the data source `find` carries the macro pair unchanged (kanban also hands it to the lane component). The calendar ANDs its own visible-window node computed from browser dates beside it, which is existing behaviour and the subject of #29117. A real Console run against a server (REST row counts, datetime last-day coverage) is NOT MEASURED here; the card's own REST readings show the server resolves these tokens, including a `datetime` column's last day.
- **Other builder surfaces:** the builder is shared, so Studio's view filter, the dataset filter inspector and sharing-rule criteria get the same choices. Each stores the same spec tokens, and the server resolves them on every ObjectQL read and write path and in the analytics executor (`resolveFilterTokens`), which a sharing rule's `engine.find` goes through.
- No docs page documents the builder's value editors (`content/docs/frontend/renderers.mdx` lists the renderer only), so no docs edit.

## Verification

The 34 derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`) ran at `35916c61` (after merging `origin/main`): 34/34 exit 0, `--ran` reconciliation 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` at the same head: 169 files passed, 2 skipped, exit 0. The full `packages/components` suite at `007ea328` (before that merge): 471 files passed, 1 skipped, 4530 tests, in four locked batches.

`origin/main` was merged again before opening (head `64a3459f`; incoming commits touch none of this PR's files, and leave the reused i18n keys unchanged). Re-run there: the 24 `filter-builder*` files (446 tests) green, `@object-ui/components` type-check exit 0, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-sdui-manifest`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check:nul-bytes` exit 0. Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs.
